title: Preclinical evidence construction for epigallocatechin-3-gallate against non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: a meta-analysis and machine learning study.
authors: Zhang, Yuanhao; Li, Jianguo; Wang, Zexin; Chen, Jie; Zhao, Maoyuan; Guo, Cui; Wang, Tingyao; Li, Ruilin; Zhang, Hebin; Ma, Xiao; Wen, Yueqiang; Zeng, Jinhao; Efferth, Thomas
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文为EGCG治疗非酒精性脂肪肝的荟萃分析与机器学习研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) has emerged as a significant health concern worldwide, exhibiting an increasing incidence that necessitates immediate intervention. Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) has shown significant pharmacological benefits for liver diseases, including NAFLD. However, its efficacy in this context has not been systematically evaluated. PURPOSE: This meta-analysis aimed to consolidate preclinical evidence on the effectiveness and mechanisms of EGCG in treating NAFLD. METHODS: We conducted a comprehensive literature search for preclinical studies from the inception of each database to April 2024, including Excerpta Medica Database, PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang, and China Science and Technology Journal Database. These studies were manually screened based on predefined criteria. Data extraction was followed by pooled effect size calculations using Stata 16.0. A machine learning approach was also utilized to examine the temporal relationships among variables. RESULTS: Seventeen studies, involving 293 animals, were analyzed. Our analysis indicates that EGCG significantly reduces ALT, AST, hepatic triglyceride, serum TG, hepatic TC, serum TC. The targets of EGCG may include antioxidants, regulation of lipid metabolism, anti-inflammation, improvement of insulin resistance, and inhibition of hepatic fibrosis. EGCG exerted its effects on NAFLD by modulating key signaling pathways, including PI3K/Akt/AMPK, TGF-beta/Smad, Nrf2, NF-kappaB, and ROS/MAPK, highlighting its multifaceted mechanisms of action. The machine learning methods employed to ascertain the temporal relationship between the intervention and the outcome indicated that the optimal duration of the intervention was 10 to 15 weeks. CONCLUSIONS: The efficacy of EGCG in treating NAFLD has been predicted within a time frame of 10-15 weeks. It may exert its effects primarily through the NF-kappaB and Nrf2 pathways, which regulate the ROS phenotype. EGCG may represent a promising target for the treatment of NAFLD.
abstract_zh: 背景：非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）已成为全球范围内的重要健康问题，其发病率不断上升，亟需立即干预。表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（EGCG）在肝脏疾病（包括NAFLD）中显示出显著的药理益处。然而，其在此方面的疗效尚未得到系统评估。目的：本荟萃分析旨在整合关于EGCG治疗NAFLD有效性和机制的临床前证据。方法：我们对截至2024年4月各数据库建库以来的临床前研究进行了全面文献检索，包括荷兰医学文摘数据库、PubMed、Web of Science、Cochrane图书馆、中国知网、万方和中国科技期刊数据库。这些研究根据预设标准进行人工筛选。数据提取后，使用Stata 16.0进行合并效应量计算。还采用机器学习方法检查变量间的时间关系。结果：共分析了17项研究，涉及293只动物。我们的分析表明，EGCG显著降低ALT、AST、肝脏甘油三酯、血清TG、肝脏TC、血清TC。EGCG的靶点可能包括抗氧化、调节脂质代谢、抗炎、改善胰岛素抵抗和抑制肝纤维化。EGCG通过调节关键信号通路（包括PI3K/Akt/AMPK、TGF-beta/Smad、Nrf2、NF-kappaB和ROS/MAPK）对NAFLD发挥其作用，凸显了其多方面的作用机制。用于确定干预与结局之间时间关系的机器学习方法表明，最佳干预持续时间为10至15周。结论：EGCG治疗NAFLD的疗效已在10-15周的时间框架内得到预测。其可能主要通过调节ROS表型的NF-kappaB和Nrf2通路发挥其作用。EGCG可能代表治疗NAFLD的一个有前景的靶点。
